# iru_ade_integration (Data Source)

Reads supported ADE integration metadata for one exact UUID through GET only. Returns the observed default Blueprint/routing assignment, enrollment contact, server name and reported token expiry. Does not expose Apple server tokens, recover the resource's local renewal version, renew tokens, assign devices or create/update/delete integrations. Missing/null required fields and inconsistent assignment metadata fail instead of inventing defaults. This single-object endpoint is not paginated.

Reads default Blueprint/routing selection, sensitive enrollment contacts, server
name and reported expiry for one integration UUID. Apple token bytes, consumer
secrets and local renewal versions are excluded. Expiry metadata does not prove
token validity or enrollment success. Legacy fixed-Blueprint and explicit routing
response forms are described in the [ADE guide](../guides/ade-routing-contract.md).

See [configuration lookup behavior](../guides/configuration-lookups.md) for
selection, errors, nulls and sensitive state handling.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing ADE integration record UUID.
data "iru_ade_integration" "selected" {
  integration_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-000000000096"
}

output "ade_server_name" {
  value = data.iru_ade_integration.selected.server_name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Exact existing ADE integration UUID, not an Apple token, server UUID, device UUID or display name.

### Read-Only

- `access_token_expiry` (String) Reported expiry string only. Not token bytes, a local renewal version or a guarantee of current token validity/device enrollment.
- `blueprint_id` (String) Observed default Blueprint UUID, or null when the integration explicitly uses Blueprint routing. A missing assignment is an error, not an inferred routing choice.
- `email` (String, Sensitive) Reported default enrollment contact email, sensitive in displays and stored in state. Preserves explicit empty strings; missing/null is an error.
- `id` (String) Canonical ADE integration UUID.
- `phone` (String, Sensitive) Reported default enrollment contact phone, sensitive in displays and stored in state. Preserves explicit empty strings; missing/null is an error.
- `server_name` (String) Apple server display name reported by Iru.
- `use_blueprint_routing` (Boolean) Observed routing choice. Legacy nested Blueprint responses imply false; current routing=true requires explicit blueprint_id=null. Reading never changes enrollment assignments.
